findings.evidence: `signatureSwitchSplitIndexEquiv` (line 733) builds the split only from `splitLastEquiv (p + 1)`, and `splitLastEquiv n : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Fin n ⊕ Fin 1` (line 428) is generic in `n`; `signatureSwitchSplitWeight_inl` (line 768) and `_inr` (line 789) discharge via `realCliffordWeight_of_lt`/`_of_le` with `i.castSucc.isLt` and `simp`, none of which assume `1 ≤ p`.
findings.fix: State it as `(realCliffordForm (p + 1) q).IsometryEquiv ((realCliffordForm p q).prod (QuadraticMap.sq ..))`, with `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry_fst_pos` at `i : Fin p`, `_fst_neg` at `i : Fin q`, `_snd` at `Fin.castAdd q (Fin.last p)`; instantiate at `p + 1` inside `realCliffordSignatureSwitchRecurrenceEquiv` (line 1038), whose own `p + 1 + 1` indexing is correct and unchanged.
findings.issue: `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry` is published only as `(realCliffordForm (p + 1 + 1) q).IsometryEquiv ((realCliffordForm (p + 1) q).prod sq)`, but nothing in the construction needs two positive coordinates. Its docstring ("splits the last positive coordinate from a real signature") promises the general fact; a consumer wanting `Cl-form(1, q) ≅ Cl-form(0, q) ⊞ ⟨1⟩` (p = 0) cannot get it and must restate and re-prove the whole block.

findings.evidence: `signatureSwitchStandardIndexEquiv` (line 877) uses `splitLastEquiv q`, `Equiv.sumAssoc`, `Equiv.sumComm (Fin 1) (Fin (p + 1))`, `Equiv.sumComm (Fin q) (Fin (p + 1))` and `finSumFinEquiv` — every step is generic in the second block size; `signatureSwitchStandardWeight_inl` (line 913) closes with `realCliffordWeight_of_le`/`_of_lt` plus `simp`/`norm_num`, with no lower bound on `p`.
findings.fix: State it as `((-(realCliffordForm p q)).prod (QuadraticMap.sq ..)).IsometryEquiv (realCliffordForm (q + 1) p)`, with `_neg` at `i : Fin p` and `x : Fin (p + q) → ℝ` (`_pos` and `_last_positive` unchanged apart from the index type); instantiate at `p + 1` in `realCliffordSignatureSwitchRecurrenceEquiv`.
findings.issue: Same defect, second instance: `realCliffordSignSwitchStandardIsometry` is published as `((-(realCliffordForm (p + 1) q)).prod sq).IsometryEquiv (realCliffordForm (q + 1) (p + 1))` although its construction is generic in `p`. The `p = 0` case is exactly the boundary identity `Cl(1, q) ≅ Cl(q + 1, 0)` (compose `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry` at p = 0, `signSwitchEquiv`, and this isometry), which the mod-8 classification needs and which this PR's surface cannot state.

summary: The `SignSwitch.lean` surface is minimal and correctly characterized, but the two new public coordinate isometries in `BottPeriodicity.lean` are published at an artificially narrowed index (`p + 1` where their construction is generic in `p`), so the general one-line-peel and sign-switch-to-standard facts — including the `p = 0` boundary `Cl(1,q) ≅ Cl(q+1,0)` the mod-8 table needs — are not expressible from this PR's API.
